envVars.STORAGE_PROVIDER: Which installed provider stores objects: `cloudflare` (add storage-cloudflare) or `memory` (add storage-memory). Always required — there is no default, so nothing writes to a real bucket by accident and nothing stops writing silently.
envVars.STORAGE_URL_SECRET: HMAC key that signs the upload and download links the proxy route accepts. Required — nothing generates one. Make it with `openssl rand -base64 32`, put it in `.dev.vars` for local dev, and set it in production with `wrangler secret put STORAGE_URL_SECRET`.
envVars.STORAGE_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES: Per-file upload cap in bytes. Defaults to 104857600 (100 MiB), which is the Free-plan Worker request body limit. This is the only limit v1 enforces: a tenant can still accumulate objects without bound.
envVars.STORAGE_PROXY_URL: Absolute origin the proxy route answers on (e.g. https://api.x.com), for a caller on another origin. Optional: with it unset a proxy link is root-relative.
